name: Goldener Stern
beschreibung:
Located in the charming town of Lienz against the backdrop of the Lienz Dolomites, Hotel Goldener Stern offers comfortable rooms and attentive service in a relaxed setting.

The historic main square, the Zettersfeld and Hochstein cable cars, and the Drau cycle path are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Goldener Stern in Lienz features alpine charm and warm hospitality in sunny East Tyrol.
